verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst explicitly enables business users to ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL, grounded on Snowflake's Semantic Views which model business metrics/entities to prevent hallucinated joins, all governed under Snowflake's RBAC and access-history/auditing layers. This directly matches the story's requirement for governed, semantically-grounded NL answers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., third-party benchmark or user report) validating accuracy/quality of Cortex Analyst's answers in practice, and more detail on how governance controls specifically apply within Cortex Analyst queries.
